title: Employee CSV summary at three levels of abstraction
task: Implement `staff.Summarize(r io.Reader) (Summary, error)` over CSV rows `name,department,salary_cents,start_date` (dates as `2006-01-02`): headcount per department, average salary per department in whole cents rounded down, and the name of the longest-serving employee overall. Blank lines are ignored and a bad row is an error naming its line number. Keep parsing rows, aggregating departments, and picking the veteran at their own levels.
